tables.title: TABLE I. - DESIGN DATA
tables.notes: Two printed blocks 'Subsonic stages' (1-9: the stages of the original nine-stage subsonic design of reference 6, of which stages 3-8 are used here) and 'Transonic stages' (1-2) kept as separator rows. No units printed (angle in deg). Second read from zoomed crop done.

tables.title: TABLE II. - VECTOR-DIAGRAM DATA (a) Rotor.
tables.notes: Column groups: Entrance (Z, X, Y', h, V'/Ut, M', β'), Change through blade row (Δh, Δβ'), D'. Stage and axial station printed on first line of each block; repeated on every line. '-----' cells printed as dashes. Second read from 1.7x zoomed crops done. See notes.md for the numerical checks.

tables.title: TABLE II. - Concluded. VECTOR-DIAGRAM DATA (b) Stator.
tables.notes: Columns: Entrance (Z, X, Y, h, V/Ut, M, β), Change through blade row (Δh, Δβ), D. Second read from 1.7x zoomed crops done. Stage 5 line Z=.9520: Δβ printed '21..70' (stray dot), transcribed 21.70. Stage 6 line Z=.8839: X printed with a smudge ':6813', transcribed .6813.

tables.title: TABLE III. - BLADE DESIGN DATA (a) Rotor.
tables.notes: Units were printed inside the headings; repeated in row 2. Number of blades printed once per stage (first line). '----'/'-----' cells printed as dashes (CL,i not applicable to the circular-arc transonic rotors 1-2; φ not applicable to 65-series rotors 3-8). Second read from zoomed crop done.

tables.title: TABLE III. - Concluded. BLADE DESIGN DATA (b) Stator.
tables.notes: Stage 1 line Z=.8941: setting angle printed '21:3' (smudged dot), transcribed 21.3. Second read from zoomed crop done; solidity = N c/(2π r_t Z) with r_t = 10 in. checks for every stator line.

tables.title: TABLE I. - DESIGN DATA
tables.notes: Station 1 has blank cells except β = 0; station 9 has only Tn/Tn-1. Stations 1-9 are stage-entrance stations of the modified compressor (Fig. 2 of RM E55B28), numbered differently from RM E53I24. Text (pdf p. 5): 'the values of area ratio, radius ratio, design temperature ratio (ref. 1), and absolute air angle (ref. 1) presented in table I' - i.e. temperature ratio and air angle are from the original design (RM E53I24); area and radius ratios are for the modified flow passage. Second read done.
